title: Wistia email 4 video thumbnail click win

change.control: Email 4 about video voicemails uses a plain static image.
change.variant: Overlay a video play button and timestamp on the same image in email 4, keeping copy and subject identical.

quote: We had 25.23% more clicks on the video thumbnail version than the image version.
notes: Distinct randomized email send in a seven-test series; recipient lists sometimes overlap. Outcome includes clicks on all email links, not just thumbnail clicks. Preserve reported lift rather than recomputing rounded rates or reconciling click-count discrepancies. 50/50 list split reported but arm sample counts not separately published.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
